lines.zh: 我掠过草尖，脚下的土烫得发红。
lines.en: I skim the grass tips; the soil beneath glows red-hot.

lines.zh: 我们顺着焦痕找回去年的猎场。
lines.en: We follow the scorch marks back to last season's hunting ground.

lines.zh: 翅膀收半寸，我贴着金合欢飞。
lines.en: Wings half-folded, I glide along the acacia line.

lines.zh: 焦土一路铺开，同伴就找得到我。
lines.en: The burnt trail spreads behind; my flock can find me.

lines.zh: 面具在前头引路，比我认得方向。
lines.en: The mask leads the way better than I know it.

lines.zh: 我看见角马群，队形立刻散开。
lines.en: I spot the wildebeest herd; our formation breaks apart at once.

lines.zh: 爪尖勾住枯枝，我停一停再走。
lines.en: Talons hook a dead branch; I pause before moving on.

lines.zh: 头冠上的光把草叶照成琥珀色。
lines.en: The glow on my crest turns the grass amber.

lines.zh: 队伍排成一线，谁都不抢先。
lines.en: We form a single line; no one breaks ahead.

lines.zh: 今早的草太干，走两步就起火。
lines.en: The grass is so dry this morning it catches at every step.

lines.zh: 我从白蚁丘上跳过，翅风扬起灰。
lines.en: I vault the termite mound; my wingbeat lifts the ash.

lines.zh: 面具在耳边低响，催我快些。
lines.en: The mask hums at my ear, urging me faster.

lines.zh: 三只同伴绕着我飞，像在清点人数。
lines.en: Three flockmates circle me, as if counting heads.

lines.zh: 我们绕开村庄，只追草原上的兽。
lines.en: We skirt the village and chase only the savanna beasts.

lines.zh: 我低飞过草丛，火苗跟着蹿起。
lines.en: I skim low over the grass and flames leap up behind me.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，焦痕画出弧线。
lines.en: I bank, and the scorched trail draws an arc.

lines.zh: 我歪着头听远处蹄声。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward hooves far off.

lines.zh: 面具悬着不动，我也不动。
lines.en: The mask hangs still; so do I.

lines.zh: 阳光晒热背羽，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sun warms my back feathers; I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声干哑的鸣叫。
lines.en: A dry, rasping cry rolls out of my throat.

lines.zh: 爪下的土还是温的。
lines.en: The earth under my talons is still warm.

lines.zh: 我在等风把猎物的气味送上来。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to carry prey scent up.

lines.zh: 那片烧黑的地是我昨天留下的。
lines.en: That blackened patch is where I stood yesterday.

lines.zh: 面具边缘的裂纹又长了一点。
lines.en: A crack on the mask's rim has grown a little.

lines.zh: 同伴在树顶打盹，我替它守着。
lines.en: A flockmate dozes in the canopy; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 远处的秃鹫不敢落下来。
lines.en: The vultures in the distance dare not land.

lines.zh: 我用喙理了理胸前的羽。
lines.en: I run my beak through the feathers on my chest.

lines.zh: 鸣叫传到对岸，没人应。
lines.en: My call crosses the valley; nothing answers.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进我的焦土了。
lines.en: Your boots are standing in my scorched ground.

lines.zh: 你身上没有羽毛，也没有面具。
lines.en: You have no feathers and no mask.

lines.zh: 面具转过来，正对着你。
lines.en: The mask turns and faces you squarely.

lines.zh: 你手里那把弓，我看见了。
lines.en: That bow in your hand — I've seen it.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，像根没烧完的树桩。
lines.en: You stand too straight, like a half-burnt stump.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的肉干是哪来的？
lines.en: Where did the dried meat at your belt come from?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，看你会不会退。
lines.en: I stare into your eyes to see if you'll step back.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏不像猎物。
lines.en: Your gait doesn't sound like prey.

lines.zh: 面具在你面前停住，像在称量。
lines.en: The mask halts before you, as if weighing you.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味盖过了草味。
lines.en: The smell of iron on you drowns out the grass.

lines.zh: 羽下渗出血，我压住翅膀。
lines.en: Blood seeps beneath my feathers; I clamp my wing down.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的俯冲。
lines.en: That blow broke off my dive.

lines.zh: 面具裂了一道，光暗下去。
lines.en: A crack splits the mask; its light dims.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着往高处退。
lines.en: I shriek and retreat into the height.

lines.zh: 我的爪还在，还能再抓一次。
lines.en: My talons are intact; I can strike once more.

lines.zh: 同伴立刻补上我的位置。
lines.en: A flockmate instantly fills my place.

lines.zh: 疼得翅发抖，我也不落地。
lines.en: My wing shakes with pain; I still won't touch the ground.

lines.zh: 你打中了翅根，飞起来会歪。
lines.en: You hit my wing joint; I'll fly crooked.

lines.zh: 我抖落几根焦羽。
lines.en: I shake loose a few singed feathers.

lines.zh: 面具在替我吸收这一击。
lines.en: The mask is soaking up part of the blow.

lines.zh: 你把生肉举高些，我够得到。
lines.en: Hold the raw meat higher — I can reach it.

lines.zh: 那块肉的血还没干，我闻得到。
lines.en: That meat's blood is still wet; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 面具说可以靠近，我才靠近。
lines.en: The mask says it's safe to come near, so I do.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，爪子先落地。
lines.en: I shuffle closer one step at a time, talons first.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，退开三步。
lines.en: Put the food down and back away three steps.

lines.zh: 这味道比角马的幼崽还香。
lines.en: This smells richer than a wildebeest calf.

lines.zh: 我低下头，这是我不常做的动作。
lines.en: I lower my head — a thing I rarely do.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我眼睛跟着转。
lines.en: Stop swinging that meat; my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 我只吃你手里的，不吃地上的。
lines.en: I'll take it from your hand, not from the ground.

lines.zh: 面具在发抖，它也想要一口。
lines.en: The mask quivers; it wants a bite too.

lines.zh: 撞上我的翅膀，你会被烫到。
lines.en: Bump into my wing and you'll feel the heat.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，羽毛擦过你的肩。
lines.en: I veer aside; my feathers brush your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，收脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail — pull your foot back.

lines.zh: 两只同伴挤在一起，谁都不让。
lines.en: Two flockmates jostle, neither giving way.

lines.zh: 翅骨很硬，撞的人更疼。
lines.en: My wing bones are hard; the one who hits them hurts more.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，面具却往前顶。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, but the mask pushes forward.

lines.zh: 我们一起落地，扬起一片灰。
lines.en: We land together and raise a cloud of ash.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的起飞路线了。
lines.en: You're blocking my takeoff path.

lines.zh: 撞一下不算冒犯，别伸手抓羽。
lines.en: A bump is no insult — just don't grab my feathers.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，焦痕在脚边拐了个弯。
lines.en: I go around you; the scorch trail bends at my feet.

lines.zh: 我们的面具靠在一起，会亮得更久。
lines.en: Our masks touch and burn brighter, longer.

lines.zh: 你替我理后颈的羽，我替你守巢。
lines.en: You preen my nape; I guard your nest.

lines.zh: 这片焦土够大，能容两个巢。
lines.en: This burnt ground is wide enough for two nests.

lines.zh: 我们轮流孵，谁都不离巢太久。
lines.en: We take turns brooding; neither stays away long.

lines.zh: 我衔来最直的枯枝给你。
lines.en: I bring you the straightest dead branch I can find.

lines.zh: 两只面具并排悬着，像一对小太阳。
lines.en: Two masks hang side by side like twin suns.

lines.zh: 你的叫声比我的低半度。
lines.en: Your call sits half a note below mine.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我们换个背风的枝头。
lines.en: The wind has turned; let's move to a sheltered branch.

lines.zh: 我把猎物最嫩的那块留给你。
lines.en: I save the tenderest cut of the kill for you.

lines.zh: 巢下的草被我们踩成了灰。
lines.en: The grass beneath the nest is trampled to ash.

lines.zh: 地上那枚面具，我捡起来看看。
lines.en: I'll pick up that fallen mask and look it over.

lines.zh: 我叼起猎物，重量刚好。
lines.en: I lift the carcass in my beak; the weight is right.

lines.zh: 这块骨头能磨爪，我带走。
lines.en: This bone will hone my talons; I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我爪子里勾住了一小片铁。
lines.en: A scrap of iron snags on my talon.

lines.zh: 面具掉了，我得把它捡回来。
lines.en: My mask fell; I have to retrieve it.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛不是我的，我捡了。
lines.en: This feather isn't mine, but I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我把肉干埋进灰里，留着以后吃。
lines.en: I bury the dried meat in the ash for later.

lines.zh: 那枚亮东西在我爪下滚了半圈。
lines.en: The shiny thing rolls half a turn under my claw.

lines.zh: 我一次只拿一样，多了会掉。
lines.en: I carry one thing at a time; more would drop.

lines.zh: 谁掉的皮革？我先收着。
lines.en: Whose hide is this? I'll hold on to it.

lines.zh: 那只落单的幼兽，归我们了。
lines.en: That strayed calf is ours now.

lines.zh: 我看见它的后腿在抖。
lines.en: I see its hind leg trembling.

lines.zh: 面具收窄了光，锁在它身上。
lines.en: The mask narrows its light and fixes on it.

lines.zh: 它在逆风跑，闻不到我们。
lines.en: It runs upwind; it can't smell us.

lines.zh: 我说了算这一次，跟我上。
lines.en: I call this one — follow me in.

lines.zh: 那只羊离群了，正好。
lines.en: That sheep has left the flock — perfect.

lines.zh: 爪尖一紧，我知道该动了。
lines.en: My talons tighten; I know it's time.

lines.zh: 同伴从两侧压低，堵住退路。
lines.en: Flockmates drop low on both sides, cutting the retreat.

lines.zh: 我看见它的眼睛，它也看见我了。
lines.en: I meet its eyes, and it meets mine.

lines.zh: 这个猎物够全群吃一顿。
lines.en: This kill will feed the whole flock once.

lines.zh: 我盯住最慢的那一只。
lines.en: I fix on the slowest one.

lines.zh: 面具亮了一下，就是信号。
lines.en: The mask brightens once — that's the signal.

lines.zh: 再近十步，我就扑下去。
lines.en: Ten more paces and I dive.

lines.zh: 它往左拐，我提前切过去。
lines.en: It turns left; I cut across ahead of it.

lines.zh: 我压着高度，等它跑累。
lines.en: I hold low and wait for it to tire.

lines.zh: 翅尖划开热风，我追得很稳。
lines.en: My wingtips slice the hot wind; I hold the chase.

lines.zh: 它躲进灌木，我绕到另一头。
lines.en: It hides in the brush; I circle to the far side.

lines.zh: 面具在我眼前投出一道细光。
lines.en: The mask casts a thin beam before my eyes.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，第三步就落爪。
lines.en: I count its strides; on the third, I strike.

lines.zh: 同伴在上面盘旋，它没处跑。
lines.en: Flockmates circle above; it has nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 尘土太大，我改用耳朵判断。
lines.en: Too much dust — I track it by ear instead.

lines.zh: 它越快，我越不急着下手。
lines.en: The faster it runs, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到它背上。
lines.en: My shadow lands on its back before I do.

lines.zh: 它开始喘了，快了。
lines.en: It's panting now — almost there.

lines.zh: 第一爪撕开它的肩。
lines.en: My first talon stroke opens its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我砍完就退，换同伴上。
lines.en: I slash and pull back; a flockmate takes over.

lines.zh: 双爪一起落下，它没再站起来。
lines.en: Both talons fall together; it doesn't rise again.

lines.zh: 面具替我挡住它的角。
lines.en: The mask takes the blow of its horn for me.

lines.zh: 我抓的是腿，让它跑不动。
lines.en: I go for the legs so it can't run.

lines.zh: 羽毛炸开，我把力气全压在爪上。
lines.en: Feathers flare as I drive all my weight through my talons.

lines.zh: 它踢空了，我的爪正好落在颈侧。
lines.en: It kicks at air; my talons land on its neck.

lines.zh: 我一声尖叫，全群一起扑。
lines.en: I shriek once, and the whole flock dives.

lines.zh: 割开皮就够了，肉还要留给幼鸟。
lines.en: One cut is enough; the meat goes to the chicks.

lines.zh: 我得换个角度，它的皮太厚。
lines.en: I need a new angle; its hide is too thick.

lines.zh: 我从焦黑的巢里挣出来。
lines.en: I struggle out of the charred nest.

lines.zh: 第一口空气里全是灰和阳光。
lines.en: My first breath is all ash and sunlight.

lines.zh: 面具先醒，然后才是我。
lines.en: The mask wakes first, then me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子烫着新生的草地。
lines.en: My talons scorch the new grass.

lines.zh: 头顶传来同伴的叫声，我抬头。
lines.en: A flockmate calls overhead; I look up.

lines.zh: 翅膜还没干，我试着张开。
lines.en: My wing membrane is still damp; I try to spread it.

lines.zh: 金合欢的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: The acacia's shadow falls over me.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，脚下就冒烟。
lines.en: The moment I stand, smoke rises under me.

lines.zh: 这片草原的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I memorize the smell of this savanna.

lines.zh: 有人在远处看着我，我不认识。
lines.en: Someone watches from afar; I don't know them.

lines.zh: 我自己就会放火，不怕这点焰。
lines.en: I set fires myself; this flame doesn't scare me.

lines.zh: 落地砸出坑，我的翅骨咔了一声。
lines.en: I hit the ground hard; my wing bone clicks.

lines.zh: 水熄了我的羽，沉得飞不起来。
lines.en: Water drowns my feathers; I'm too heavy to fly.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的面具掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocks my mask askew.

lines.zh: 箭穿进翅膀，我数着它拔出来。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my wing; I count as I pull it free.

lines.zh: 这股光和我面具的光不一样。
lines.en: This light is not the light of my mask.

lines.zh: 空肚子让我的爪发软。
lines.en: An empty belly makes my talons weak.

lines.zh: 天火比我的焦痕亮得多。
lines.en: Sky-fire burns far brighter than my scorch marks.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，连灰都没有。
lines.en: There is nothing below — not even ash.
